gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-fresca: Neuropolitical pulls its words apart letter by letter, each small letter a big open counter lit like a glowing neon tube. Fresca, free of calligraphic thinning, handles the steady reading instead.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-funnel-sans: Reading feels crisp here, with strokes that stay put from stem to curve and an e opened like a pried clasp. Funnel Sans handles the reading while Neuropolitical, pulled apart letter by letter, handles the looking.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-gafata: Neon-tube letters, pulled apart one by one, light up Neuropolitical's gentle line. What stands out most is the gap in temperament: Gafata's tall, wide-eyed lowercase against all that neon glow.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-geist: Words pulled apart letter by letter, in neon-tube lines with big open counters, make Neuropolitical feel lit from inside. Geist, quiet and level, does the reading while that one does the shouting.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-georama: Georama has a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart and capitals that barely rise. Neuropolitical's crossbars, fat as the stems they join, stand tall against that low, friendly text.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-gidole: Clean terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades give Gidole a tidy, neon-tube consistency in every stroke. And what ties them is a shared tube-drawn line, with Neuropolitical simply spacing its letters apart.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-golos-text: Neuropolitical pulls its neon-tube letters apart, one by one. Golos Text fills the line with its tall x-height, plus a widely parted s, so the lit-up heading gets a friendly neighbor.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hedvig-lett: Neuropolitical draws every letter with a ruler's constant width, pulled apart so each small letter shows a big open counter. And Hedvig Letters Sans, with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, keeps the page grounded.
